About Armor & Ink™ → Read Our Full Story

More than
a clothing
store.

Armor & Ink™ was born from a woman who loves God, who walks in boldness, and who wanted every woman she met to feel exactly what she feels — seen, heard, and loved. Not occasionally. Not conditionally. Always.

Our founder built this brand as a reminder: you are essential. Women are the incubators of life — we carry, we nurture, we birth, we sustain. That is not small. That is everything. Armor & Ink™ is the wearable declaration of that truth.

Every piece is handmade in small intentional batches using only 100% linen or 100% cotton — pure, natural, no synthetics. We do not rush. We do not mass produce. We create with purpose, because the women who wear our pieces deserve nothing less.

  • Founded by a woman of faith, tenacity, and bold love
  • A reminder that you are seen, heard, valued, and essential
  • Handmade in small batches — never mass produced
  • 100% natural fabrics only — linen or cotton, always
  • Every piece — a mission, not just a moment
“You are seen. You are heard. You are loved. You are essential. You are the incubator of life itself — and every piece you wear should remind you of that truth.”

Shipping Policy

All Armor & Ink™ garments are made to order and require a production window of 2–3 weeks before shipment.

Domestic Orders (United States): Free shipping on all domestic orders. Orders are shipped via USPS Priority Mail or UPS Ground within the continental United States. Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number via email.

International Orders: International shipping is available for select regions. Shipping costs for international orders are calculated based on destination and order weight and will be communicated to you prior to fulfillment. International customers are responsible for any customs duties, taxes, or import fees assessed by their country upon delivery.

Armor & Ink™ is not responsible for delays caused by carriers, customs, or circumstances beyond our control.

Refund & Return Policy

All sales are final. Armor & Ink™ does not accept returns or issue refunds. Because every piece is made to order and handmade in small intentional batches, these beautiful dresses cannot be resold or restocked. We encourage all customers to carefully review sizing guides and reach out with questions before placing an order. In the rare event of a manufacturing defect or error on our part, please contact us within 5 days of delivery at armorandink@pm.me and we will work to make it right. We take great pride in the quality of every garment we produce.

Privacy Policy

Armor & Ink™ collects personal information — including your name, email address, shipping address, and payment details — solely for the purpose of processing and fulfilling your order. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. Payment information is processed securely through our payment provider and is never stored on our servers. We may use your email to send order updates and, with your consent, occasional news about new collections. You may opt out at any time. By placing an order, you agree to the collection and use of information as described in this policy.

Terms of Service

By accessing the Armor & Ink™ website and placing an order, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. All content on this site — including images, text, designs, and the Armor & Ink™ name and logo — is the exclusive intellectual property of Armor & Ink™ and may not be reproduced, distributed, or used without express written permission. Armor & Ink™ reserves the right to refuse service, cancel orders, or modify product offerings at any time. Prices are subject to change without notice. These terms are governed by the laws of the state in which Armor & Ink™ operates.

Size Guide

All Armor & Ink™ pieces are designed with an intentional oversized architecture. Our silhouettes are built to flow, drape, and move — that is the design. You do not need to size up. Order your true size and wear the boldness.

Size Chart

SizeUS SizeBustWaistHip
XS0 – 232–33″24–25″34–35″
S4 – 634–35″26–27″36–37″
M8 – 1036–37″28–30″38–40″
L12 – 1438–40″31–33″41–43″
XL16 – 1842–44″34–36″44–46″

All measurements are in inches. Due to the generous, oversized architecture of every Armor & Ink™ piece, these garments are designed to fit with significant ease — draping beautifully across all body types.

A note on our fabrics: Every piece is made from 100% linen or 100% cotton — pure natural fabrics, never blended with synthetics. Natural fabrics have slight variation in feel and drape batch to batch, which is part of what makes each piece uniquely yours.

Our Story

Armor & Ink™ was born from a place of deep faith, bold love, and an unshakeable belief that every woman deserves to feel exactly what she is: seen, heard, and loved.

Our founder is a woman who loves God. She built this brand not as a fashion label, but as a declaration — a daily, wearable reminder of truth. She wanted women everywhere to carry that reminder on their bodies, in how they move, and in how they show up in the world.

She understood something profound: women are the incubators of life itself. We carry, we nurture, we birth, we sustain. We are essential — not as a supporting role, but as the foundation. Armor & Ink™ exists to remind every woman of that truth every time she gets dressed.

Every piece is a reflection of her tenacity, her boldness, and her belief that you do not need to shrink to be accepted. You are seen. You are heard. You are loved. You are prominent. You are present.

This is not fast fashion. This is not mass production. Every garment is handmade in small intentional batches, crafted from 100% linen or 100% cotton — no synthetics, no shortcuts, no compromise. We create with the same care and intention with which we built this brand: deliberately, purposefully, and for you.

Armor & Ink™ — Inked in Purpose. Sealed by Grace. Armored by Truth.

Our Community

Armor & Ink™ is more than a clothing brand — it is a community of women who walk in boldness, live with purpose, and refuse to be invisible.

We are building a space for women who understand their value. Women who know they are seen. Women who have been told to quiet down, take less space, and shrink — and have chosen not to.

When you wear Armor & Ink™, you join that community. You carry a reminder on your body that you are essential, powerful, and present. You become part of a movement of women declaring their truth — not with words, but with how they show up.

Follow us and share your story. Tag us. Tell us how you arrived. We want to see every woman who wears our pieces stepping into her Presence, her Prominence, and her power.

Contact Us

We would love to hear from you. Whether you have a question about an order, need guidance on sizing, or simply want to connect — we are here.

Email: armorandink@pm.me

Response Time: We respond to all inquiries within 1–2 business days. We are a small, intentional operation and we give every message the attention it deserves.

Orders: All orders are processed through PayPal. Once your order is placed, you will receive a confirmation. Production begins immediately and takes 2–3 weeks. You will receive tracking once your piece ships.

Shipping: Free on all domestic (US) orders. International orders are welcome — shipping costs will be confirmed before fulfillment. International customers are responsible for any customs or import fees.

Please note: All sales are final. Because every piece is handmade to order, we do not accept returns. If there is an issue with your order, please reach out within 5 days of delivery and we will make it right.
